name: Bajč (Slovakia)
description: Nine horizontal stripes alternating dark green, light green and yellow, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature B-191/2002.

features.role: dark green, light green and yellow stripes
